when: Applies when selecting formatting to emphasise words.
Single quotation marks are one possible alternative unless they are serving a different stylistic use.
rules.why: G-3 records optional emphasis methods as conditions; the prohibition on italic emphasis with an available alternative is the actionable rule.

anchor.quote: If you do this, write ‘emphasis added’ in square brackets following the italicised text.

covers.quote: If the italics is part of the original text, write ‘emphasis from original’ in the square brackets following the quotation.

tags.violation_condition: Italic emphasis in a quotation lacks the required square-bracketed provenance label, has the wrong label, or has the label in the wrong position.

when: For italics added to a quotation, write [emphasis added] following the italicised text.
For italics present in the original, write [emphasis from original] following the quotation.
Adding italic emphasis to a quotation is optional.
rules.why: G-2 keeps the two provenance cases in one annotation check; G-3 does not turn optional added emphasis into a requirement.
